The structure of LiCoSi₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/a (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Li₄Co₄Si₈) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 10 neighbors (2 Co, 4 Li, 4 Si), Li centers with 9 neighbors (3 Co, 6 Si), and Si centers with 9 neighbors (3 Co, 3 Li, 3 Si). The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Li polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among like Co, Li, and Si polyhedra.
